nodes.body: this is pre-existing but feels a bit scary 😅 of course, I can add the new methods to `fakeAuthorizer` too separately, but I figured that in one sense it could be useful to audit where this allow-all one is actually used instead of reimplementing it.
I'd prefer adding the new method to the local test-only fakeAuthorizer (like in plugin/pkg/admission/gc/gc_admission_test.go) to keep the diff small and obviously additive to 1.36

👍 this is restoring the 1.36 WantsAuthorizer signature

```diff
git diff upstream/release-1.36 HEAD -- staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/initializer/interfaces.go
diff --git a/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/initializer/interfaces.go b/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/initializer/interfaces.go
index cd3da1a6195..55f80679076 100644
--- a/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/initializer/interfaces.go
+++ b/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/admission/initializer/interfaces.go
@@ -43,7 +43,13 @@ type WantsExternalKubeInformerFactory interface {
        admission.InitializationValidator
 }
 
-// WantsAuthorizer defines a function which sets Authorizer for admission plugins that need it.
+// WantsUnconditionalAuthorizer defines a function which sets a narrower, conditions-unaware UnconditionalAuthorizer for admission plugins that need it.
+type WantsUnconditionalAuthorizer interface {
+       SetUnconditionalAuthorizer(authorizer.UnconditionalAuthorizer)
+       admission.InitializationValidator
+}
+
+// WantsAuthorizer defines a function which sets a standard, possibly conditions-aware Authorizer for admission plugins that need it.
 type WantsAuthorizer interface {
        SetAuthorizer(authorizer.Authorizer)
        admission.InitializationValidator
```
